board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-031 knock sensor module (SEN-KY031KS)
reason: Modelled as an active-low spring contact from S to GND with the on-board 10 kOhm pull-up to + (header S, +, -). The debounced falling-edge IRQ driver passes the part check on ESP32 and Pico: the example prints 'S=0 knocking=1 total=1' when the knock toggle is on.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/en/sensors/ky-031 (Signal, +V, GND); https://www.circuitbasics.com/how-to-setup-vibration-sensors-on-the-arduino/ (S, middle 5V, -); https://www.codrey.com/?p=8168 (10k between S and V, H->L pulse on knock)
